name: 18301 · E Stroudsburg, PA
findings: ZIP 18301 (E Stroudsburg) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18301 (E Stroudsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18301 (E Stroudsburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
